# DIRcreative

> DIRcreative is a chat-first Codex Skill for AI film preproduction: reference-video analysis, creative direction, screenplay and dialogue development, production ledgers, detailed storyboards, visual asset planning, Seedance 2.5/2.0 prompt compilation, sound planning, and evidence-bound quality review before video generation.

Use the root Skill as the only public entrypoint. Internal modules ship with DIRcreative. The explicit dependency installer includes a licensed hash-locked humanizer-zh snapshot and can synchronize Jingzao from its official latest stable Release. Other providers, including Sepia and mr-li-seedance-25, remain separately installed; not every provider is bundled. Model and service access is not included. A planned prompt, local candidate, generated file, human approval, and published release are different states.

## AI video workflows

- [Reference-video distillation](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/blob/main/skills/dircreative/references/video-distillation.md): Evidence-first video breakdown and transferable production-method analysis.
- [Storyboard coverage](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/blob/main/skills/dircreative/references/storyboard-coverage.md): Within-shot action panels, reverse shots, eyelines, and coverage validation.
- [Seedance compilation](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/blob/main/skills/dircreative/references/script-to-seedance.md): Script-to-Seedance handoff, visual baseline, asset bindings, continuity, and duration rules.
- [Humanization workflow](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/blob/main/skills/dircreative/references/humanization-workflow.md): Two-stage diagnosis and evidence-bound text editing without flattening voice.
- [Visual Skill Stack](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/Paperrolling-DIRcreative-SKILL/blob/main/skills/dircreative/references/visual-skill-stack.md): Conditional provider selection, context budgets, and ownership boundaries.
